learned_patterns.pattern: The Signal Engine has produced no matrix since 2026-06-30 (7 days) and no session updated memory 07-01→07-06, yet an agentic INTC stop-loss still fired 07-07. Risk controls (stops) execute autonomously; the analytical/reporting loop does not. A silent engine outage can persist for days while trades still happen — decouple these in monitoring so the outage surfaces immediately.

INTC's fractional stop was 12.6% ($112.06) but it exited at $109.01 (-14.98%) — the week-long slide gapped past the stop before the sell landed. Confirms §3/§7.1: between-session fractional stops cap tail risk but cannot recover a gap already opened. The structural fix is lower-vol instrument selection (INTC ATR was 7.6% at entry — a high-vol LAB name).

The INTC stop-out took LAB 25.9% → 18.0%, under the 20% cap, with no deliberate trim — exactly the §17.3 mechanism (organic exits normalize an over-cap sleeve; force-selling is forbidden). Over-cap LAB is meant to resolve via market exits and base growth, and it just did.

The weekly reversal concentrated its damage in the single high-vol name: INTC -21% (stopped out) vs SOXX -9.95%, QQQ -1.91% for the diversified ETFs that carry no stops and stayed intact. Diversification buffered the CORE drawdown the single stock could not — direct support for the §13 ETF-migration thesis.
